analyst.summary: Sanofi Consumer Healthcare India owns well-known OTC brands including Combiflam and Allegra, demerged from Sanofi India in 2023. The business has a clean, debt-free balance sheet and strong brand equity in categories with real repeat-purchase economics, but the reported 38% revenue growth partly reflects demerger-year comparison effects rather than a sustainable run-rate, and the stock's ~41x earnings multiple already prices in the brand quality. We rate this a Hold.
